channel.title: Easy Japanese For Work
channel.desc: This episode is about asking questions using polite Japanese, \"keego.\" Irving Armenta-san, from Mexico, has trouble with \"keego.\" As a college student, he became a fan of a Japanese singer. To understand her songs, he attended a Japanese language school. Irving-san has no trouble with daily conversation. He works at an IT company with a casual atmosphere, where \"keego\" is not quite necessary. But soon, Irving-san will begin working at the clients' office 2 days a week. He will need to improve his \"keego!\.
